columns.comment: CRM activity id.
columns.name: activity_id

columns.comment: Date of the activity.
columns.name: activity_date

columns.comment: First day of the month of the activity.
columns.name: activity_month

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year as its starting calendar year (FY2026 = Apr 2026 - Mar 2027).
columns.name: fiscal_year

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year label, e.g. FY2026 (Apr 2026 - Mar 2027).
columns.name: fiscal_year_label

columns.comment: Fiscal quarter label, e.g. FY2026-Q2 (Jul-Sep 2026).
columns.name: fiscal_quarter_label

columns.comment: Fiscal half label, e.g. FY2026-H1 (Apr-Sep 2026).
columns.name: fiscal_half_label

columns.comment: Surrogate key of the dim_client version valid on this row's date (SCD2 as-was join, D11); join to gold.dim_client.golden_client_sk for the client attributes at that time.
columns.name: golden_client_sk

columns.comment: Durable golden client id from entity resolution (GC-nnnnnn), stable across ER runs and SCD2 versions; one golden client = one resolved legal entity.
columns.name: golden_client_id

columns.comment: Client group (global parent group) id from the Tokyo HO group master (SYN-G-nnnn); join to gold.dim_client_group.
columns.name: client_group_id

columns.comment: CRM account id (source record of the CRM platform) the row was recorded against.
columns.name: crm_account_id

columns.comment: Employee id of the RM who logged the activity; join to gold.dim_employee.
columns.name: rm_employee_id

columns.comment: CRM code of the RM who logged the activity (RM001-RM120).
columns.name: rm_code

columns.comment: Coverage office of the RM (APAC booking location, e.g. SG).
columns.name: rm_office

columns.comment: Client contact met (CRM contact id); join to gold.dim_contact.
columns.name: contact_id

columns.comment: Role of the contact: CFO, Treasurer, CEO, Procurement Head, Other or Unknown.
columns.name: contact_role

columns.comment: Seniority of the contact as recorded in CRM.
columns.name: contact_seniority

columns.comment: Call, Meeting, Email, Video Call or Site Visit.
columns.name: activity_type

columns.comment: True for meetings and site visits.
columns.name: is_in_person

columns.comment: Purpose: Account Planning, Relationship Review, Product Discussion, Deal Progress, Signal Follow-up, Credit Review, Service Review, Market Update or Courtesy Visit.
columns.name: purpose

columns.comment: Subject line of the activity.
columns.name: subject

columns.comment: Product discussed (CRM sales product, e.g. Supply Chain Finance, Cash Management Mandate); null when none.
columns.name: product_discussed

columns.comment: dim_product key of product_discussed.
columns.name: product_discussed_id

columns.comment: Product family of the product discussed; null when none.
columns.name: product_family

columns.comment: RM call note (synthetic, <= 40 words).
columns.name: note_text

columns.comment: Tone of the note as written: Positive, Neutral or Negative.
columns.name: note_tone

columns.comment: Note sentiment -1 (very negative) .. +1 (very positive), deterministic from the tone; average it.
columns.name: sentiment_score

columns.comment: True when the activity set a follow-up action.
columns.name: action_required

columns.comment: Follow-up action agreed (short text).
columns.name: next_action

columns.comment: Due date of the follow-up action.
columns.name: next_action_due_date

columns.comment: Status of the follow-up at the as-of date: Open, Overdue or Completed (null without an action).
columns.name: next_action_status

columns.comment: True when the follow-up is still open at the as-of date (Open or Overdue) - Next Actions Open.
columns.name: is_next_action_open

columns.comment: True when the follow-up is overdue at the as-of date.
columns.name: is_next_action_overdue

columns.comment: Opportunity signal the activity followed up (fact_opportunity_signal.signal_id).
columns.name: related_signal_id

columns.comment: Pipeline opportunity the activity progressed (fact_pipeline_opportunity.opportunity_id).
columns.name: related_opportunity_id

columns.comment: Duration of the activity in minutes.
columns.name: duration_minutes

columns.comment: Days from the activity to the as-of date 30-Sep-2026.
columns.name: days_before_as_of

columns.comment: True for activities in the 90 days to the as-of date (1-Jul to 30-Sep-2026).
columns.name: is_last_90_days

comment: RM engagement log (Account Planning, mv_rm_engagement): one row per CRM activity with a client - calls, meetings, emails, video calls and site visits from Apr-2024 to Sep-2026 - with the RM, the client contact and role (CFO, Treasurer, CEO, Procurement Head), the purpose and product discussed, a short note (<= 40 words), the note sentiment (-1 negative .. +1 positive) and the follow-up action with its status at the as-of date. Count rows for activity volumes and distinct golden_client_id for clients touched; average sentiment_score. Grain: one row per CRM activity.
